The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 98a7e721547308b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 48-49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Suppose the current state is nonterminal, its smoothing index satisfies i < J0, and N is sufficiently large with all parameters fixed. For every prescribed T > 0, it is bounded, apart from an error O(R−T ) from oscillatory operations, by a sum of child bounds THE FALCONER DISTANCE CONJECTURE 49 whose number is polynomial in N, and possibly a low-frequency stopping term. For every non-low child, if the old start is a and the new start is a′, its multiplier is R−2(Aa′ −Aa)+cost+Cdσ+o(1) . (9.9) A low child has cost zero and the entire multiplier Ro(1), with no fixed Cdσ loss. A low-frequency stopping term is RCdσ+o(1). The legal children are Reduction Parent and child Cost Suffix Di(a, t) → Di+1(a, p) Ap − min[p,t] A Low Di(a, t) → Di+1(a, v) 0; full factor Ro(1) High Di(a, t) → H [a,t] i (p, v) k(a, p) Direct HB i (a, v) → HB i (p, v) k(a, p) Near HB i (a, v) → HB i (h, v) 0 Far HB i (a, v) → Di+1(b, v) 0 For a positive parent, p is its current interval’s fixed policy choice. The suffix row is used when 2p > a + t. When 2p ≤ a + t, the shell index is an integer a < v ≤ t: the low row has t − v ≥ σN, and the high row has 0 ≤ t − v < σN. A high child has base [a, t] and carries the fixed enlarged derivative budget and common angular bounds produced by the inverse conversion; these depend on T and the fixed parameters, not on N. For an angular parent, use L0, h from Equation (9.8). If h ≤ a, the direct row chooses a remaining descriptor of maximal length L, its anchor p, and an origin [b0, u0] ⊆ B for that membership. This choice has L = L0, a < p < v, b0 ≤ p − L, p + L ≤ u0, v − a ≤ 2L, and it supplies the parallel descriptor [max(a, p − L), p] used by the graph estimate. If h > a, the near row uses the displayed depth h. The far rows range over integer depths b arising from the comparable far displacements, with a < b ≤ h + Od(1) < v, and use separated depth-b cell pairs. Direct and near children keep the same base, index, derivative budget and common angular bounds. A far child has the fresh positive list M(b, v). Finite maxima over child cells use the stated geometry. Whenever admissible symbols vary, take a supremum over the symbol family just specified. An empty collection of child terms contributes zero. Constants outside powers of R may depend on the fixed parameters, derivative budgets and angular bounds. The constants Cd in exponent losses depend only on d. A terminal state is bounded by RCd(κ+σ)+o(1) . (9.10)
